mutations.description: Increase curation threshold to capture more quality hypotheses
mutations.justification: Curation rate of 6.2% is extremely low with strong score-feedback correlation (0.85), indicating the threshold is too restrictive and filtering out viable hypotheses
mutations.estimated_impact: Expected 40-50% increase in curated hypotheses (from ~10 to ~15 per cycle)
mutations.observation_summary: Curation rate 6.2% with 0 hypotheses scoring above 0.5, but strong correlation suggests scoring is accurate

mutations.description: Increase novelty weight to boost scores for innovative hypotheses
mutations.justification: Score distribution shows no hypotheses above 0.5, and underexplored domains (Ceramics, Biomaterials, Surface Science) suggest novelty should be more heavily rewarded
mutations.estimated_impact: Expected 5-10% increase in average composite scores, particularly for interdisciplinary bridges
mutations.observation_summary: Score distribution heavily skewed low (0.3-0.5 range) with promising underexplored domains identified

mutations.description: Slightly widen the semantic distance range to capture more diverse domain combinations
mutations.justification: Bridge rate is 100% but underexplored domains suggest the system may be missing valuable combinations by being too restrictive on semantic distance
mutations.estimated_impact: Expected 10-15% increase in domain diversity, particularly accessing underexplored Ceramics and Biomaterials domains
mutations.observation_summary: Multiple underexplored domains identified despite 100% bridge rate, suggesting distance constraints may be limiting exploration

rationale: The system shows strong score-feedback correlation (0.85) indicating good calibration, but has a very low curation rate (6.2%) and average scores clustering in the 0.3-0.5 range with no hypotheses scoring above 0.5. The primary issues are: (1) overly restrictive curation threshold preventing good hypotheses from being selected, (2) score distribution suggests the scoring system may be too conservative, and (3) promising underexplored domains need better access. Focus on improving curation rate while maintaining quality.
expected_outcomes: Higher average composite scores through novelty emphasis
Better access to underexplored domains (Ceramics, Biomaterials, Surface Science)
Maintained quality due to strong existing score-feedback correlation
risks: Slightly more hypotheses to review (manageable increase)
Potential for marginally more speculative hypotheses
Need to monitor if quality remains high with increased volume
